description: Once a one-to-one conversation moves to its agent's row, Leave Group and Delete Group are reached only by right-clicking the envelope; a right-click elsewhere on the row gives the pane's menu. Consider adding the group's items to the pane row's menu.
title: Reach a one-to-one group's Leave and Delete from the whole agent row
